Complete Guide to URL Encoder / Decoder

Web addresses frequently contain special characters, spaces, and query parameters that must be properly percent-encoded to prevent broken links and server misinterpretations. TECHTIS URL Encoder / Decoder simplifies encoding and decoding URLs for developers, digital marketers, and system administrators.

In addition to standard RFC 3986 encode and decode operations, our tool automatically analyzes the input string to detect query parameters, presenting them in an organized key-value table. This makes it effortless to audit UTM tracking tags, OAuth callback parameters, and API query parameters.

Because the tool operates 100% client-side in your web browser, confidential URLs containing session tokens, reset links, or internal server addresses remain entirely secure on your machine.

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about URL Encoder / Decoder and privacy

How to URL encode or decode special characters online for free?
Paste your URL or text into TECHTIS URL Encoder/Decoder. Choose 'Encode' to convert special symbols into percent-encoded entities (e.g. space to `%20`, `&` to `%26`), or 'Decode' to restore readable text. Click to copy your output instantly.
What is the difference between encodeURI and encodeURIComponent?
The standard 'Component' mode encodes all reserved characters (including `/`, `?`, `&`, `#`) suitable for query string parameter values. The 'Full URI' mode preserves valid protocol and domain structures.
Are my confidential URLs or authentication tokens uploaded to any server?
No! All encoding and decoding execute strictly in your local browser JavaScript engine. Zero data leaves your device.
Can this tool handle non-ASCII characters and foreign scripts?
Yes! UTF-8 characters (including Hindi, Chinese, and emojis) are encoded into proper multi-byte percent-escaped sequences.
Does this tool work on mobile phones?
Yes, you can encode and decode URLs on iOS Safari and Android Chrome smoothly.
Does TECHTIS charge for URL encoding?
No. TECHTIS is 100% free with unlimited usage.
Does this tool work completely offline?
Yes! Once loaded in your browser cache, the tool functions without an internet connection.
How fast is URL encoding and decoding?
Operations complete instantaneously in system memory.
